# Read Shared Report
Read an already published public BrewPage report into Langflow as escaped source text. No model, account or API key.

1. Use only a report intended for public sharing; copy its page ID, not its full URL.
2. In Settings > MCP Servers, add **BrewPage Reports** with Streamable HTTP URL `https://brewpage.app/mcp`; no authentication. Select it in MCP Tools, then select **get_page**.
3. Keep Namespace fixed to **public**. If discovery clears the ID connection, reconnect Chat Input to **Id**. Leave Tool Mode off.
4. Enter your public report ID in Chat Input, open Playground, and run manually. No automatic reads or retries.

The result is report text, not an HTML preview. HTML and Markdown delimiters are escaped to prevent active markup and remote images. Public report outputs remain in your local Langflow chat history. Expired/missing reports produce an error. This template never publishes, changes or deletes content; private/password-protected pages and owner credentials are not supported.
